## Land use raster plots:

```{r}

# Download required databases (mwbugs and mwstr) to local directory (local_dir):
if (!dir.exists("gpkg")) dir.create("gpkg") # Safely creates a new folder if it doesn't already exist
urls <- c("https://tools.thewerg.unimelb.edu.au/mwbugs/data/mwbugs_db_v2.1.1.gpkg", # 50.7MB
          "https://tools.thewerg.unimelb.edu.au/mwstr/data/mwstr_v1.3.1.gpkg")      # 780.0MB
options(timeout = 900) # Increases time to download files through R - default timeout is 60 seconds.
for (url in urls){
  if (!file.exists(paste0("gpkg/", basename(url)))){
    print(paste("Downloading", basename(url)))
    download.file(
      url, 
      destfile = paste0("gpkg/", basename(url)), # file path where the downloaded file is to be saved.
      mode = "wb") # Code written to download binary files must use mode = "wb" (or "ab")
  }
}

source("~/uomShare/wergStaff/ChrisW/mwstr_v13/mwstr_network_functions.R")

# prepare_af_site_data(mwstr_connection, tiff_dir):
# mwstr_connection: connection to the melbourne water stream network database from DBI
# tiff_dir: directory

tiff_dir <- "~/uomShare/wergStaff/ChrisW/mwstr_v13/"
str_db <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "gpkg/mwstr_v1.3.1.gpkg")

# 1: Prepare the AF data for calculation (compile raster stack from subcs table)
prepared_data <- prepare_af_site_data(str_db, tiff_dir)

# 2: Calculate AF for a gien reach or sitecode
sitecode_or_reach <- "LIS_453g"
dL = 35 
dW = 1000

list2env(prepared_data,environment())

# take the site-level character identifier
last_char <- substr(sitecode_or_reach,
                    nchar(sitecode_or_reach),nchar(sitecode_or_reach))
# reach code for site
reachi <- ifelse(last_char %in% 0:9, sitecode_or_reach,
                 substr(sitecode_or_reach,1,nchar(sitecode_or_reach)-1))

# site code for site
sitei <- subcs$site[subcs$reach == reachi]

# Calculate the proportion of the reach that is upstream of the site:
ppn_us <- ifelse(last_char %in% 0:9,
                 0, (match(last_char,letters[1:10]) - 1) * 0.1)

# Distance upstream in meters:
m_dus <- ppn_us * subcs$tot_length_m[subcs$site == sitei]

# calculate distance to outlet for site i:
d2oli <-  subcs$d2ol_pp[subcs$site == sitei] + m_dus

# All upstream subcatchments:
allusi <- subcs$site[igraph::subcomponent(subcs_ig, as.character(sitei), "in")]
allusi_d2ol <- subcs$d2ol_pp[match(allusi,subcs$site)]
  # See code block in c6-trees (form L365) of mwstr-manual for justification

# maximum upstream distance for AF calc: 
max_us <- 10 * dW  # This was 6 * dW in version 1.3.1: very little difference

# set boundary for upstream based on 16 * dW:
allusi_within_max_us <- allusi[allusi_d2ol < d2oli + max_us]
# Doesn't exclude upstream subcatchments in this case

# restrict subcatchment to gridcells within 16 * dW:
cati <- subcs[subcs$site %in% allusi_within_max_us,]
# terra::plot(cati)
# create forest spatial subset from raster stack 
rasti <- terra::crop(trees_4, cati, mask = TRUE)
# terra::plot(rasti)
# Set null values for new forest cover data imputation (i.e., calculated AF)
# cuts out sites along the reach before the current site (everything before j)
terra::values(rasti$d2ol)[terra::values(rasti$d2ol) < d2oli] <- NA

# mask i
# some edge inconsistencies
mski <- rasti$site
# terra::plot(mski)
# remove sites not in allusi_within_max_us
terra::values(mski)[!terra::values(mski) %in% allusi_within_max_us] <- NA
# terra::plot(rasti)
# 
msk <- terra::ifel(mski, NA, rasti$d2ol)
rasti <- terra::mask(rasti, msk)
rasti <- terra::trim(rasti)
rasti$d2ol <- rasti$d2ol - rasti$d2str - d2oli 
  #d2str not substracted from d2ol in version 1.3.1 and earlier. It is necessary to separate water distance from land distance
  # see ~/git/mwstr_impervious_estimation/forest cover metric estimation.qmd L113 for equivalent buffer calculation
weight <- exp(log(0.5)*rasti$d2str/dL)*exp(log(0.5)*rasti$d2ol/dW)
af_series <- c(af_1750 = NA, af_2006 = NA, af_2018 = NA, af_2022 = NA)
for(k in 1:4){
    # If no tree-cover at all, af raster is only NAs, so set to zero.
    af_series[k] <- ifelse(is.na(terra::global(rasti[[k+3]] * weight, fun= sum, na.rm = TRUE)$sum),
                           0,
                           terra::global(rasti[[k+3]] * weight, fun= sum, na.rm = TRUE)$sum/
                             terra::global(weight*25, fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE)$sum)
}
gc()
# af_series


```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# Plot attenuation-weighted forest cover for four AF variants
# ============================================================

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(terra)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(patchwork)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Download required databases (mwbugs and mwstr) to local directory (local_dir):
if (!dir.exists("gpkg")) dir.create("gpkg") # Safely creates a new folder if it doesn't already exist
urls <- c("https://tools.thewerg.unimelb.edu.au/mwbugs/data/mwbugs_db_v2.1.1.gpkg", # 50.7MB
          "https://tools.thewerg.unimelb.edu.au/mwstr/data/mwstr_v1.3.1.gpkg")      # 780.0MB
options(timeout = 900) # Increases time to download files through R - default timeout is 60 seconds.
for (url in urls){
  if (!file.exists(paste0("gpkg/", basename(url)))){
    print(paste("Downloading", basename(url)))
    download.file(
      url, 
      destfile = paste0("gpkg/", basename(url)), # file path where the downloaded file is to be saved.
      mode = "wb") # Code written to download binary files must use mode = "wb" (or "ab")
  }
}

tiff_dir <- "~/uomShare/wergStaff/ChrisW/mwstr_v13/"
source("~/uomShare/wergStaff/ChrisW/mwstr_v13/mwstr_network_functions.R")

str_db <- DBI::dbConnect(
  RSQLite::SQLite(),
  "gpkg/mwstr_v1.3.1.gpkg"
)

prepared_data <- prepare_af_site_data(
  str_db,
  tiff_dir
)

list2env(prepared_data, environment())

# Site or reach
sitecode_or_reach <- "LIS_453g"

# Site coordinates
site_coord <- 

# Parameter combinations
L_values <- c(5, 35)
W_values <- c(100, 1000)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Identify site and upstream subcatchments
# ------------------------------------------------------------

last_char <- substr(
  sitecode_or_reach,
  nchar(sitecode_or_reach),
  nchar(sitecode_or_reach)
)

reachi <- ifelse(
  last_char %in% 0:9,
  sitecode_or_reach,
  substr(
    sitecode_or_reach,
    1,
    nchar(sitecode_or_reach) - 1
  )
)

sitei <- subcs$site[subcs$reach == reachi]

ppn_us <- ifelse(
  last_char %in% 0:9,
  0,
  (match(last_char, letters[1:10]) - 1) * 0.1
)

m_dus <- ppn_us *
  subcs$tot_length_m[subcs$site == sitei]

d2oli <- subcs$d2ol_pp[subcs$site == sitei] +
  m_dus

# All upstream subcatchments
allusi <- subcs$site[
  igraph::subcomponent(
    subcs_ig,
    as.character(sitei),
    "in"
  )
]

allusi_d2ol <- subcs$d2ol_pp[
  match(allusi, subcs$site)
]

# Use the largest W to define a common spatial extent
max_us <- 10 * max(W_values)

allusi_within_max_us <- allusi[
  allusi_d2ol < d2oli + max_us
]

cati <- subcs[
  subcs$site %in% allusi_within_max_us,
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Prepare the common raster
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rasti <- terra::crop(
  trees_4,
  cati,
  mask = TRUE
)

# Exclude locations downstream of the site
terra::values(rasti$d2ol)[
  terra::values(rasti$d2ol) < d2oli
] <- NA

# Exclude locations outside the upstream subcatchments
mski <- rasti$site

terra::values(mski)[
  !terra::values(mski) %in% allusi_within_max_us
] <- NA

msk <- terra::ifel(
  mski,
  NA,
  rasti$d2ol
)

rasti <- terra::mask(rasti, msk)
rasti <- terra::trim(rasti)

# Calculate distance upstream from the site
rasti$d2ol <- rasti$d2ol -
  rasti$d2str -
  d2oli

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Calculate weighted forest cover
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# parameter_grid <- tidyr::crossing(
#   W = W_values,
#   L = L_values
# ) |>
#   mutate(
#     panel = case_when(
#       L == 5  & W == 100  ~ "(a)",
#       L == 35 & W == 100  ~ "(b)",
#       L == 5  & W == 1000 ~ "(c)",
#       L == 35 & W == 1000 ~ "(d)"
#     ),
#     panel = factor(
#       panel,
#       levels = c("(a)", "(b)", "(c)", "(d)")
#     ),
#     label = paste0(
#       panel,
#       "  L = ", L, " m, W = ", W, " m"
#     )
#   )

# Define the four parameter combinations in the order you want them plotted
parameter_grid <- data.frame(
  L = c(Inf, Inf, 35, 35),
  W = c(Inf, 1000, Inf, 1000)
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    panel = c("(a)", "(b)", "(c)", "(d)"),
    label = paste0(
      panel,
      "  L = ", L, " m, W = ", W, " m"
    )
  )

# plot_data <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
#   parameter_grid,
#   function(W, L, panel, label) {
# 
#     # Attenuation weights
#     weight <- exp(
#       log(0.5) * rasti$d2str / L
#     ) * exp(
#       log(0.5) * rasti$d2ol / W
#     )
# 
#     # Weighted forest cover for 2022
#     weighted_cover <- rasti[[7]] * weight
# 
#     df <- terra::as.data.frame(
#       weighted_cover,
#       xy = TRUE,
#       na.rm = TRUE
#     )
# 
#     names(df)[3] <- "weighted_cover"
# 
#     df$panel <- panel
#     df$label <- label
# 
#     df
#   }
# )

plot_data <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  parameter_grid,
  function(L, W, panel, label) {
    
    # Calculate attenuation weights
    weight <- exp(
      log(0.5) * rasti$d2str / L
    ) * exp(
      log(0.5) * rasti$d2ol / W
    )
    
    # Calculate weighted forest cover for 2022
    weighted_cover <- rasti[[7]] * weight
    
    # Convert to a data frame for ggplot
    df <- terra::as.data.frame(
      weighted_cover,
      xy = TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    names(df)[3] <- "weighted_cover"
    
    df$panel <- panel
    df$label <- label
    
    df
  }
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_data$weighted_cover_p <- plot_data$weighted_cover
plot_data$weighted_cover_p <- plot_data$weighted_cover_p/25
plot_data$weighted_cover_p[plot_data$weighted_cover_p > 1] <- 1

p <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    fill = weighted_cover_p
  )
) +
  geom_raster() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ label,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  coord_equal(
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  # scale_fill_viridis_c(
  #   option = "D",
  #   name = "Weighted\nforest cover"
  # ) +
  
  # Adding a point at the site:
  
  
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "grey",  
      "darkgreen",  
      # "green",  
      "green2"  
    ),
    name = "Weighted\neffect"
  ) + 
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Attenuation-weighted forest cover:",
      sitecode_or_reach
    ),
    subtitle = "2022 forest cover",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),

    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "grey92",
      colour = NA
    ),

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 20
    ),

    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),

    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 11
    ),

    panel.spacing = grid::unit(
      1,
      "lines"
    )
  )

p

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Export for PowerPoint
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = "AF_parameter_comparison.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## Contours etc.

### Data prep:

```{r}
#| label: load_data


af_loo_table <- readRDS(file = "~/uomShare/wergStaff/tewilkins/git-data/env_optimisation/af_loo_full_and_pruned.rds")

#af_loo_table <- data.frame(model = row.names(af_loo_table), af_loo_table, row.names = NULL)
af_loo_table$diff_by_se <- af_loo_table$elpd_diff/af_loo_table$se_diff
af_loo_table$W <- af_loo_table$L <- NA
lws <- strsplit(substr(af_loo_table$model,5,nchar(af_loo_table$model)-2),"w")
af_loo_table$L[1:(length(lws)-1)] <- as.numeric(lapply(lws[1:(length(lws)-1)],"[[",1))
af_loo_table$W[1:(length(lws)-1)] <- as.numeric(lapply(lws[1:(length(lws)-1)],"[[",2))
af_loo_table$map <- substr(af_loo_table$model, nchar(af_loo_table$model), nchar(af_loo_table$model))
af_loo_table$map <- ifelse(af_loo_table$map == "f", "full", "pruned")
af_loo_table$diff_by_se <- af_loo_table$elpd_diff/af_loo_table$se_diff
af_loo_table$diff_by_se[1] <- 0
af_loo_table$perc_bad_pareto_k <- NA
# for(i in 1:nrow(af_loo_table)){
#   looi <- loo_list[[i]]
#   looi_ks <- looi$diagnostics$pareto_k
#   af_loo_table$perc_bad_pareto_k[i] <- 100*sum(looi_ks > 0.7)/length(looi_ks)
# }
af_loo_table$looic_diff <- af_loo_table$looic - min(af_loo_table$looic)

saveRDS(af_loo_table, file = "temp/af_loo_table.rds")

```

### AF figures:

```{r}
#| label: af_full_contour
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6


library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(metR)

af_loo_table <- readRDS(file = "temp/af_loo_table.rds")

af_loo_full <- af_loo_table[af_loo_table$map == "full" & !is.na(af_loo_table$L),]

# Remove L = 3.75 row:
af_loo_full <- af_loo_full[af_loo_full$L != 3.75,]

# Remove W = 625 and 633:
af_loo_full <- af_loo_full[!(af_loo_full$W %in% c(625, 633)),]

# Find the best point:
best_af <- af_loo_full[which.min(af_loo_full$looic_diff),]

p <- ggplot(
  af_loo_full,
  aes(x = L, y = W, z = looic_diff)
) +
  geom_contour(
    aes(colour = after_stat(level)),
    bins = 12,
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    direction = -1,
    name = expression(Delta * "LOOIC")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Overland HDD (m)",
    y = "In-stream HDD (km)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      colour = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      colour = "grey20"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "grey25"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = NA
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = best_af,
    aes(x = L, y = W),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1.2,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black"
  ) + 
  geom_text_contour(
    aes(z = looic_diff),
    bins = 12,
    size = 3.5,
    stroke = 0.2,
    colour = "grey15"
  )

p 
```
